theme: Light mode by default with high-contrast Dark Navy sections (e.g., Hero or Revenue Management feature section) for visual rhythm and authority. No generic center alignments.

rules.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-tight font-extrabold text-left
rules.h2: text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-bold text-left

colors.rules: No violet/purple gradients. Avoid pure black/white. Use text shadow over images to pass APCA contrast. Buttons and highlights use primary blue. Dark backgrounds for data/analytics sections to convey power.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix of Flat Solid backgrounds for trustworthiness and Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for sticky header only.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle 1px borders on feature cards (border-black/5 in light mode, border-white/10 in dark mode).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse, ambient shadows for interactive elements. Flat design for foundational elements. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(29,78,216,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-lg) for buttons and cards. Organic feel, not heavily bubbled.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 for sections to give breathing room.
layouts.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Bento Grid (Mode A) for the Features section. Asymmetrical layouts: e.g., col-span-8 for primary feature (PMS), col-span-4 for secondary (Guest Exp). Never center everything.
layouts.alignment: Strictly left-aligned text for readability. Optical alignment for icons.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for pricing/feature cards. Primary buttons: bg darkens (hover:bg-[#1E40AF]), text remains white.
motion.scroll: Smooth reveal using framer-motion (y: 20 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1) staggered for lists and grid items.
motion.micro: Interactive elements must feel tactile. Provide immediate visual feedback.

components.navigation: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-background_light/80, z-50. Logo left, Links center, 'Sign In' (ghost/outline) and 'Request Demo' (solid primary) right.
components.hero: Asymmetrical split. Left: High-impact H1 + subtext + CTA + Trust indicators (logos). Right: High-quality product dashboard mockup overlaid on a subtle organic shape or image.
components.trust_bar: Grayscale/low-opacity logos of partner hotels/brands running in a slow, continuous horizontal marquee (react-fast-marquee).
components.features_bento: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix of tall (row-span-2) and wide cards. Each card contains a label, title, short desc, and a relevant image or UI mockup snippet.
components.testimonials: Masonry or staggered layout. Include real-sounding hotelier names, titles, hotel names, and distinct un-centered typography (e.g., large serif quotes if applicable, otherwise keep Manrope).
components.pricing: 3-column grid. Starter, Professional (highlighted), Enterprise. Distinct CTAs. Professional has 'Most Popular' badge. Enterprise CTA says 'Contact Sales'.
components.demo_form: Shadcn form components. Fields: Name, Email, Hotel Name, Room Count (select), Message. Solid background card, distinct from page background.
components.footer: Dark Navy background (#0A0F1C). Massive 'Ready to upgrade?' heading. Multi-column links. Footer text in #9CA3AF.

media.icons: lucide-react for UI actions. @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for feature representations.

images.description: Clean modern dashboard interface to represent the MyHotelBox / ReveniQ software.
Modern hotel reception desk with staff, illustrating PMS capabilities.
Guest relaxing in a hotel room looking at their phone, representing mobile check-in and messaging.
Crisp clean hotel bed representing housekeeping management.
Luxury hotel lobby to set a premium, trustworthy tone for enterprise software.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. #1D4ED8 (Primary) on white is accessible. Avoid light grey text.
accessibility.interactive: All links and buttons must have clear :focus-visible states (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-request-demo-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page at the root route ('/') using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Do NOT use a generic centered layout. Use asymmetrical grid columns.
Implement the 'Tetris' grid layout for the features section with varied card sizes and images/icons.
The 'Sign In' button in the nav must link to the dashboard login page. The 'Request Demo' button should scroll to the form.
Implement a working Demo Request form using Shadcn UI forms. Ensure fields match requirements (Name, Email, Hotel Name, Room Count, Message).
Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations.
Avoid violet, purple, or generic AI gradients. Stick to the Sapphire Blue, Dark Navy, and Earthy Sand palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Add subtle grain textures or noise overlays if possible to break digital flatness.
Use provided image URLs. Do NOT use placeholder image services.
Use Lucide React and Phosphor Icons for standard imagery.
